_comment: Machine-readable OTLP/HTTP trace endpoints per platform, consumed by
send.py and mirrored 1:1 by collector.yaml. Secrets NEVER appear here:
every credential is an ${env:VAR} placeholder resolved at runtime from
the platform's gitignored .env file (env_file below) or the process
environment. Provenance: endpoints and header names are copied from the
repo's own verified write paths — braintrust/otel_setup.py and
langsmith/otel_setup.py (OTLPSpanExporter endpoint+headers used by the
July/August demo runs), the Logfire SDK's default OTLP export target
for the davila7/ant-agent project (logfire-us.pydantic.dev, see
CLAUDE.md read-API recon), the Langfuse OTLP endpoint documented at
/api/public/otel (Basic auth pk-lf/sk-lf, same key pair the v2 read
API uses), and arize-phoenix-otel's register() which posts to
PHOENIX_COLLECTOR_ENDPOINT/v1/traces with a Bearer PHOENIX_API_KEY
(phoenix/01_messages.py docstring).
LANGFUSE_BASIC_AUTH is base64(LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY:LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY);
send.py derives it automatically when unset, the collector needs it
exported explicitly.
Project isolation (matches manifest.projects / dataset/README.md):
logfire routes by token and isolates via resource service.name;
braintrust routes via x-bt-parent; langsmith via Langsmith-Project;
langfuse is fixed by the key pair (time-window isolation); phoenix
routes via the openinference.project.name resource attribute already
embedded in every chunk.

logfire.notes: LOGFIRE_TOKEN must be a WRITE token; the read token (pylf_v2, LOGFIRE_READ_TOKEN) is query-only and is rejected by the ingest endpoint.

langsmith.notes: 1.5s pacing honors the 10 req / 10 s API rate limit. LangSmith OTLP ingest rejects spans with start_time outside +/-24h of ingest time (HTTP 422, verified live 2026-08-13) — no historical backfill; generate a --days 1 corpus with a fresh anchor and send immediately.

langfuse.notes: x-langfuse-ingestion-version:4 is REQUIRED: without it OTLP ingest is accepted but lands in the legacy path, invisible to the v2 observations read API (verified live).
